description_en: Queries the Cron Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (CronHPA) configurations of a service
description_zh: 查看服务的定时扩缩容配置详情
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-service-cron-scaler --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServiceCronScaler

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the service
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

ExcludeDates.description_en: The points in time that are excluded when you schedule a CronHPA job. The points in time must be specified by using a cron expression
ExcludeDates.description_zh: 已排除的时间点的Cron表达式列表

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the most recent CronHPA job was created. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 最后一次定时任务创建UTC时间

LastProbeTime.description_en: The time when the most recent CronHPA job ran. The time is displayed in UTC
LastProbeTime.description_zh: 最后一次定时任务的运行UTC时间

Message.description_zh: 最后一次定时任务的详细信息
Message.example: "cron hpa job scale-jobs-0 executed successfully. current replicas:3, desired replicas:2."

Name.description_en: The name of the CronHPA job

Schedule.description_en: The cron expression that is used to configure the execution time of the CronHPA job

State.description_en: The status of the most recent CronHPA job
State.description_zh: 最后一次定时任务的状态

TargetSize.description_en: The number of instances that you expect to configure for the CronHPA job
TargetSize.description_zh: 伸缩任务的目标实例数
